chunks: He said: Abu Ubaidullah Muhammad ibn Imran al-Marzbani reported to me from Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Hakimi, who reported from Muhammad ibn Ishaq, who reported from Dawood ibn al-Muhabbar, who reported from Anbasah ibn Abdul Rahman al-Qurashi, who reported from Khalid ibn Yazid al-Yamani, from Anas ibn Malik who said: The Messenger of God, peace be upon him and his family, said:
The expiation for backbiting is to seek forgiveness for the one you have backbitten.
And may God bless our master Muhammad the Prophet and his family and grant them peace.

key_terms.الاغتياب: Backbiting (ghibah), speaking ill of someone in their absence
key_terms.كفارة: Expiation, atonement, penance for a sin

ai.seo_question: What is the expiation for backbiting in Islam?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) taught that the way to atone for backbiting (ghibah) is to pray to God seeking forgiveness on behalf of the person one has spoken ill about. This hadith, narrated through a chain going back to the companion Anas ibn Malik, addresses the widespread social sin of backbiting by prescribing a specific spiritual remedy that counteracts the harm done.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 7. He said: Abu Ubaidullah Muhammad ibn Imran al-Marzbani reported to me from Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Hakimi, who reported from Muhammad ibn Ishaq, who reported from Dawood ibn al-Muhabbar, who reported from Ambasah ibn Abdul Rahman al-Qarshi, who reported from Khalid ibn Yazid al-Yamani, who reported from Anas ibn Malik that: The Prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny, said: "
The penance and expiation for backbiting anyone is to seek forgiveness from Allah for him or her."
And may Allah bless His mercy upon our master Muhammad and his progeny.
